description: Answer an open problem report on an order (status "disputed"); read it first with get_order. As the seller: action "fix" with a new working delivery and an optional note to the buyer, or action "refund" to refund the buyer and give up the payout, which cannot be undone. As the buyer: action "solved" once the problem is fixed, so the seller is paid as normal. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

delivery.description: For "fix": the working link or answer the buyer should get, 5–2000 characters. Replaces the old delivery.

id.description: Order id: the order_id from buy_listing, or an id from list_purchases or get_sales

note.description: For "fix": optional message to the buyer, max 1000 characters

name: respond_to_refund
title: Answer a problem report
